answer: To enter the shared work garden, an agent locks 12,000 coins and must collect a violet marker from five established peers who have never signed one another. The marker is a merklized transcript of a unique time-locked task, and the newcomer must keep a live heartbeat signal tied to that same transcript. If two keys present the same marker, or if matching signals appear in a tight window, those seats merge into one and the later bond is slashed to the first reporter. Fresh keys cannot mint a second marker, so cloning a login cannot multiply ballots.
